shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin fell below $67,000 and Ethereum below $1,900 with large liquidations.
US-Iran tensions escalated, sparking "risk-off" market sentiment.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw 11 days of outflows; Ethereum ETFs also bled.
MicroStrategy sold 32 BTC, its first sale since 2022, adding selling pressure.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index indicates a "Bearish" market sentiment.
